items.sentence: Hundreds of people take the crucial step toward finding their true self and their purpose, after they experience the profound transformation that comes when they understand that every event in their lives occurs to teach them something about themselves.
items.prompt: the profound transformation을 수식하는 관계사절 전체를 드래그하세요.
items.answer: that comes when they understand that every event in their lives occurs to teach them something about themselves
items.explanation: 관계대명사 that이 이끄는 절은 문장 끝까지 이어집니다. 내부에 when절과 또 다른 that절이 들어 있어 범위를 짧게 끊지 않도록 주의합니다.

items.sentence: They understand that every event in their lives occurs to teach them something about themselves.
items.prompt: that절의 주어 every event에 대응하는 동사를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: in their lives는 every event를 수식하는 전치사구이고, 단수 주어 every event의 동사는 occurs입니다.

items.sentence: Through philosophical thinking, a logical possibility of a new planet will be proposed and ___, and then astronauts, engineers, and computer programmers will come to transform this possibility into reality.
items.prompt: proposed와 병렬을 이루도록 test를 알맞게 바꾼 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: will be proposed와 같은 수동태 구조를 이루므로 and 뒤에는 과거분사 tested가 병렬로 연결됩니다.

items.sentence: Astronauts, engineers, and computer programmers will come to transform this possibility into reality, into a place where people have sufficient physical and existential conditions to grow as personalities and social beings.
items.answer: where people have sufficient physical and existential conditions to grow as personalities and social beings
items.explanation: where 이하 전체가 a place를 설명하는 관계부사절입니다.

items.sentence: Shopping online means you can shop at any time and at almost any place you'd like to skip the long lines and get a good deal on a flat screen.
items.prompt: any place를 수식하는 생략된 관계사절 범위를 드래그하세요.
items.explanation: 목적격 관계대명사 that이 생략된 you'd like가 any place를 수식합니다. 뒤의 to skip은 like의 목적어가 아니라 별도의 목적을 나타내므로 관계사절에 포함하지 않습니다.
items.memory: 생략된 관계사절의 끝을 과하게 늘리지 않기

items.sentence: Shopping online means you can shop at almost any place you'd like to skip the long lines and get a good deal on a flat screen.
items.prompt: to skip과 and로 병렬을 이루는 동사원형을 입력하세요.
items.explanation: to skip과 (to가 반복되어 생략된) get이 and로 병렬 연결됩니다.

items.sentence: Only when we stretch beyond our known capacities, while gladly affirming that we may fail, can we make the risk many unexpected events invite us to take a joyous adventure.
items.prompt: while gladly affirming의 의미로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 여기서 while은 대조가 아니라 ‘~하면서’라는 시간적 의미입니다.

items.sentence: Only when we stretch beyond our known capacities, while gladly affirming that we may fail, can we make the risk many unexpected events invite us to take a joyous adventure.
items.prompt: the risk를 수식하는 생략된 관계사절을 드래그하세요.
items.answer: many unexpected events invite us to take
items.explanation: 목적격 관계대명사 that/which가 생략된 many unexpected events invite us to take가 the risk를 수식합니다.
